  • Constructor Details

    • TransientTimeStepResult

      private TransientTimeStepResult(double outerTimeStepSeconds, double elapsedTimeSeconds, int outerIntervalCount, double massResidualKg, double maximumRelativeMassResidual, Map<String,Double> componentResidualKg, double maximumRelativeComponentResidual, double energyResidualJ, double maximumRelativeEnergyResidual, double maximumRelativeVolumeResidual, double maximumRelativeThermodynamicEnergyResidual, NetworkHydraulicModelComparison.ModelProfiles finalProfiles)
      Create one transient time-step result.
      Parameters:
      outerTimeStepSeconds - requested outer time step in s
      elapsedTimeSeconds - accepted common time horizon in s
      outerIntervalCount - number of accepted outer calls
      massResidualKg - signed sum of accepted total-mass residuals in kg
      maximumRelativeMassResidual - worst accepted total-mass relative residual
      componentResidualKg - signed accumulated named-component residuals in kg
      maximumRelativeComponentResidual - worst accepted component-inventory relative residual
      energyResidualJ - signed sum of accepted conservative-energy residuals in J
      maximumRelativeEnergyResidual - worst accepted relative energy residual
      maximumRelativeVolumeResidual - worst accepted occupied-volume residual
      maximumRelativeThermodynamicEnergyResidual - worst accepted thermodynamic recovery residual
      finalProfiles - final normalized distributed state
